title: KbmonRunStalled fires on any worker alive for an hour, because a working run posts one progress event and the silence it measures never ends while the worker lives
goal: the seconds a working run has been silent count only while its worker process is gone or has been silent in the transcript, so a worker that runs longer than the stalled threshold does not raise KbmonRunStalled, and a worker that died does

run: import re, sys; t = open('_tools/mon_export.py', encoding='utf-8').read(); m = re.search(r'working_silent.{0,2000}', t, re.S); sys.exit(0 if m and not re.search(r'pid|alive|proc', m.group(0)) else 1)

repro_reason: The false alert needs a Prometheus evaluating the rule over an hour of a live worker; what can be read here is that the silence point is computed from progress events alone, with no worker liveness.

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, sys, json, sqlite3, time
R = os.getcwd(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite'); T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '-q', T])
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
def silent(item, pid):
    c('transition', 'run/' + item, '--to', 'claimed'); c('transition', 'run/' + item, '--to', 'working')
    subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, 'own', str(pid), '--class', 'process', '--item', item], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
LIVE = subprocess.Popen(['sleep', '120'])
DEAD = subprocess.Popen(['true']); DEAD.wait()
silent('ST-aaaaaaaa', LIVE.pid)
con = sqlite3.connect(S); con.execute('UPDATE events SET at = at - 7200'); con.commit(); con.close()
def metric():
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbmon.py', '--metrics', '--panel', 'coord', '--root', T, '--store', S], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
    try:
        pts = json.loads(r.stdout)['points']
    except (ValueError, KeyError):
        return None
    return next((p['value'] for p in pts if p['name'] == 'kbmon.coord.run.working_silent'), None)
alive = metric()
LIVE.terminate()
LIVE.wait()
dead = metric()
print('silent seconds with the worker alive:', alive, '| after it died:', dead)
sys.exit(0 if alive == 0 and dead is not None and dead >= 7000 else 1)

clauses.clause: the seconds a working run has been silent count only while its worker process is gone or has been silent in the transcript, so a worker that runs longer than the stalled threshold does not raise KbmonRunStalled
